value:
THE CLOSABILITY ROSTER OF THE COMBINED FORM+RECOLOR POPULATION. THE HEADLINE IS A NEGATIVE AND IT IS DECISION-RELEVANT: THE COMBINED STAGE, ON ITS OWN, CLOSES ZERO FUNCTIONS TODAY. It is necessary for 25 functions and sufficient for none of them. THE PAYOFF-INVERSION LAW HAS NOW RECURRED A THIRD TIME, ONE LEVEL FURTHER DOWN THAN WF FOUND IT.

WHY A ROSTER IS NOT A SITE COUNT. 83 combined-stage sites (claim.law.CH_combined-stage-population-is-83-not-91-the-difference-is-the-r0-refusal.20260901.v1) live in 25 carrier functions. Carrying a site is necessary, not sufficient: a function only becomes an exact if its ENTIRE residual is absorbed. Method -- re-apply HV screens 2-3 with one change, RELAX what counts as already-handled: cn_census marks a word impure unless it is a pure register-field difference; here a word is impure only if it is `other`, so served form sites AND combined-stage sites count as handled. Then tier:
  TIER A  0 impure clusters -- the stage closes it with no permutation at all.
  TIER B  1 impure cluster, control-free -- single-window permute + stage; derive the order.
  TIER C  >1 impure cluster -- multi-region, no stage currently composes across windows.
MEASURED: TIER A 0, TIER B 2, TIER C-with-control 1, TIER C 22.

TIER A IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE STRUCTURAL FINDING. Not one of the 25 carriers has its whole residual inside the form+recolor classes. Every member needs a permutation as well, so the combined stage can never be the last stage a carrier needs -- it always composes with a reorder. Anyone scoping the stage as a standalone win should scope it as a composition instead.

TIER B, THE ONLY MEMBERS WORTH DERIVING, AND BOTH REFUSE FOR REASONS BEYOND THE STAGE:
  update_chinfo (game/audio/dcs, 75 insns, other 2, regfield 28, fwd_rc 1) is the single highest-closability member in the image: one combined site, a control-free window, and a legal derived order that passes check_permutation_dependences in OUR colouring. It STILL refuses. Simulating apply_patch's own stage order -- permute, rewrite every form-class site in either arrow and either destination, then verify_consistent_recolor with the jumptable/relocation/call-target context apply_patch builds -- leaves '+0x98: use of g23 does not correspond to g24 under the running renaming'. The residual is a WHOLESALE reallocation (r30->r27, r31->r28, r29->r26, r28->r25, r26->r31, r27->r23, r24->r29, r25->r30, r23->r24) that is not a position-consistent renaming even after the form site at +0x84 (ours `li r23,0` against the target's `mr r24,r22`) is rewritten. THE VERDICT IS SOUND ACROSS THE RELOCATION SUBTLETY: relocations ride their atom, so the first simulation passed UN-permuted offsets to the verifier; re-running with every in-window relocation mapped through the permutation (keyed by the owning instruction, per the SDA21 law) reproduces the identical refusal at the identical offset.
  vsprintf (game/crt/vsprintf, 665 insns, other 16, fwd_rc 1) admits NO legal order over its window and refuses independently at +0x28.

TIER C IS NOT AN INDEPENDENT BAR AND MUST NOT BE READ AS ONE. For the 22 Tier C members the recolor simulation trips on a `non-register bits differ` word, but that is trivially the unabsorbed `other` population restating itself, not a second mechanism -- no permutation was derived for them because their impure words span multiple clusters. Their real blocker is multi-region structure. Two members deserve naming because their bar is a DIFFERENT class again: InitOAnimList and CritterDamage refuse with 'lmw/stmw fields may not differ', i.e. register_slot_mask returns 0 for opcodes 46/47 and those words are not recolourable at all.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE STAGE, stated so it is not mistaken for an argument against building it. The stage remains correctly prioritised by SITE count and it is a prerequisite for 25 functions. But its whole-function payoff set is EMPTY at the moment it lands, so it cannot be validated by 'close a function with it' the way the pure inverse direction was, and a lane that plans to prove it that way will find nothing to point at. The nearest member is update_chinfo, which needs the stage PLUS a recolor mechanism the project does not have. Build it as an enabler, measure it by sites served, and expect the exacts to arrive only when composed with a further recolor advance.

THE PAYOFF INVERSION, THIRD INSTANCE. claim.LZ_copy-form-taxonomy-and-payoff-inversion.20260901.v1 found the unconditional class had an empty payoff set. claim.law.WF_inverse-copy-form-is-served-and-the-payoff-inversion-recurs-one-level-down.20260901.v1 found the pure inverse direction had two sites and one function. This pass finds the combined stage -- the axis those two records correctly identified as the big one BY SITES -- has zero closable functions. The generalisation earned across three instances: IN THIS CORPUS, SITE COUNT AND FUNCTION COUNT ARE ROUTINELY ANTI-CORRELATED, because the sites concentrate in large functions whose OTHER residuals are worse. Census by function-closability, not by site count, before committing a build.
